title: Plastic Cup Detective
objective: Describe the observable properties of a plastic cup and choose its safe use or handling.

items.prompt: Maxine tests objects with an adult. Which one bends easily without breaking?
items.explanation: A rubber band bends and returns to shape without shattering. Rocks, glass, and wooden sticks resist bending or can break.

items.prompt: Milo compares a cloth, foil, glass, and ruler after a spill. Which material absorbs water?
items.explanation: Cotton cloth has fibers that soak up water. Foil and glass repel water, and a ruler does not absorb it as readily.

items.prompt: Maxine presses four objects gently. Which material is hard?
items.explanation: A stone stays firm and resists bending, showing hardness. A sponge, rubber ball, and foil are softer or more flexible.

items.prompt: A child carries a plastic cup without much effort. Which property does it show?
items.explanation: The cup is easy to lift because it has little weight, so light is the observed property.

items.prompt: Before studying the plastic cup, which action is safe?

options.text: Look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking and gentle touching allow a safe observation. Tasting, throwing, and damaging the cup are not safe ways to investigate.
